meta.name: memory-alignment-check
meta.description: After QA PASS, compare the Story's implementation footprint against relevant memory entries. Reports confirmed entries, contradictions, and new knowledge candidates. Never writes to memory — produces a delta report for Discovery to action.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对比实现与内存条目，生成差异报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在 QA 后需要确认实现与先前记录的一致性
copy.tagline_en: Compare implementation against memory entries and report differences
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to verify implementation consistency against memory after QA

howto.what: 在 QA 通过后，Claude 会对比故事的实施足迹与相关记忆条目，生成一份报告，列出已确认的条目、矛盾和新的知识候选。它只生成报告，不会写入记忆。
howto.when: 在 QA 结论为“通过”后自动触发，不会在代码可能变更之前运行。

say.text: 请对刚才通过 QA 的 E01S01 故事进行记忆对齐检查。
say.note: Claude 会生成一份记忆差异报告。

say.text: 检查当前故事的实施是否与记忆一致。
say.note: 返回已确认和矛盾的条目。

howto.what_en: After QA PASS, compares the Story's implementation footprint against relevant memory entries. Reports confirmed entries, contradictions, and new knowledge candidates. Never writes to memory.
howto.when_en: Activates after the QA verdict is PASS, to avoid analysis on code that will change.

say_en.text: Run memory alignment check for story E01S01 that just passed QA.
say_en.note: Claude will produce a memory delta report.

say_en.text: Check if the current story aligns with memory.
